column1: # One TLC run per row. `expected` is the outcome on the model of the code
# at the sync commit in .claude/skills/workspace-release/SKILL.md; a fail
# names the open findings there that explain it. `fixed` is the outcome
# with every fix in fixes/ applied, checked for rows expected to fail, so a
# known finding cannot hide a new violation. Change a row only with the
# code change or model fix that changes the outcome.
